steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You wasted your chance.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: If I were you, when I caught that talking Seaborn in Sal Viento, I would've forced it to spill everything it knew about Ægir.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You've been walking the land for years. You've never heard Ægir's messages. But the ocean is different. The ocean has never been disconnected.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Yet you simply allowed it to die without creating any value. An unproductive decision, Gladiia.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I don't need to hear messages from trash. The only answers our prey can provide are the grunts of lowly beasts.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Seems you've found some assistants on land. And put quite a bit of trust in them.

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: (Howls) The cosmos... cemetery...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You're showing mercy. Why does he still stand?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...I'm not.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: He's just a little sturdier than anticipated.
The knight does not fight back. He suddenly freezes in place and throws his head back. He staggers, spins around, and looks up.
Gladiia had planned to seize this moment to put an end to the chase, but right as she is about to, she has a faint premonition.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Seaborn's scent. It's changed.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You're already sensitive enough to notice such changes then?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: That's right, Gladiia.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: No matter how much you try to console yourself or others, this is a problem we'll have to deal with, sooner or later, ourselves.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Garcia!

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Sobbing howl)

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Good... Good... You hurt it real bad! We'll track it down in no time by following these blood trails.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Wait, what are these burn marks? What did it do to my ship?!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The monster can't have left these marks behind.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That's right. It must be the masterwork of our lovely little Iberian bird. Aw, they grow up so fast.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: So who's scarier? The Seaborn or her people?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: ...You mean the Iberian from before? Her? Impossible. Any of this ship's battle-hardened sailors would've been stronger than her. How could SHE do this?

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Nibbles on the captain's sleeves)

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: No matter. Regardless of what that Iberian did, we have to hurry.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Time to put an end to this months-long hunt.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You seem to be in a pretty good mood, Mister Captain.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Good mood? Hah!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Who wouldn't be happy to bring an end to such a long hunt?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: You keep chasing. I'll go a different way. It won't cut through these walls, it'll try to get closer to the sea.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Garcia... Your wounds aren't life-threatening. Just hang in there, and we'll be right back!
The injured chief mate still needs more time to recover. It looks at its captain's face in silence.
Joy. A hard-to-disguise excitement. A vigor it has not felt in a long time.
It takes a peaceful nap, focusing its energy on rejuvenating its injured parts. All to help its lover continue the hunt.
A brief, light dream. Short, trance-like, and extremely rare since its body underwent such profound changes.
In its dream, it stands upon Iberia's shores. The sky booms with fireworks and hums with the din of whistles. A high-spirited Alfonso stands at its side, asking it a question.
Garcia.
See those kids along the shore? We all like children.
Children are the future of Iberia. Our glory, our feats, and our skills all die with us.
But children. New lives. Ones that all of Iberia will come together to nurture. And they'll inherit it all.
Garcia.
Who do you think he should take after?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (How can it still move so fast with those injuries? I can't keep up!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (And... holding back from firing my handcannon is...)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The nethersea brand has spread to the ship? But how?! It wasn't this bad a little while ago!
The fluorescing nethersea brand has devoured the golden Iberian hall.
The intricate dome reflects a ghastly blue light. And amidst the glow stands a lone, out-of-place woman.

Her two hands are crossed in front of her as she silently and carefully sizes up the throne in front of her. The nethersea brand spreads from beneath her feet, sapping the very color from the golden floor.
She turns her head. Her eyes hold nothing but compassion and expectation.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: ...Good evening, Irene.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (A Church of the Deep cultist!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Did I miss...?! No, there's no way!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Originium Arts?!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: That's right, Irene. If Dario could see you now, I'm sure he'd be so proud.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —How do you know our names? Who are you?!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I am a translator.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: You think a lie like that will do you any good?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I never lie, Irene. I've translated a great many works. Perhaps one of novels full of Gaulish critical realism on your shelves contains my touch? Have you ever even noted the name of the translator?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Look at your feet! You're the one who brought the nethersea brand?!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: That's a somewhat biased statement. I did not bring the brand. Rather, I established a bond with the fluorescent sea.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Truly, it is an honor to be a part of it.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: How did you get to this ship?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: That doesn't matter, Irene.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Nor does it matter whether you can defeat the Seaborn, whether I die here, or whether this ship will be key to reconnecting with Ægir. None of that matters.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: And yes... The sacrifices of Dario and the Penal Battalion, Gran Faro's collapse, the Eye of Iberia. The long, long time that has passed...

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: In the vast process of evolutionary transformation, all of these are but drops of water in the sea of life.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: My respect comes from the fact that we are all but a part of the Cycle. Compared to the whole, we are all insignificant.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —Wait. You mentioned the High Inquisitor. What happened to him...?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Alas, poor Irene. Look, I know the feeling of having questions and needing answers, but is this really the time? When your enemy stands right before you?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What happened to him?!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: His sacrifice was in vain, Irene.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The sea breeze brought me news of his death. You have my condolences.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Impossible... It can't be...

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Nothing is impossible, Irene.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: When the oracle descended, all the futures of this land were set in stone.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: We are bugs crawling along the ground. We ought to follow the ordained path. What's wrong with choosing a life without barriers, without separation, without country and without form?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If you choose to cease resisting, all the better. If not—

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: —If none of this really matters, Amaia, then why are you buying time for our wounded little prey?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You've woken up, Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Not completely, but I can at least remember your name. Hope I'm not coming across as rude.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Irene!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What did you do to her?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Nothing. We were only making small talk.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Skadi, continue the chase.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Wasn't it your prey?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And who was it that let me run into such a nostalgic figure?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Alright, be careful.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Irene?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: ...You're lying.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The breath of the sea does not lie.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: No, like I said, that's impossible.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The High Inquisitor's death must have had a purpose. The Inquisition never makes sacrifices in vain.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: If you don't believe that, cultist, then... I'll just have to become that purpose.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: So be it. What a resilient child you are.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Hunter, let's go!

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Oh, my dear little Irene, you've only just learned to control the power of an Inquisition handcannon, and this is how you display it?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If you continue trying to burn the nethersea brand in such a crude manner, Captain Alfonso will be furious, no?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Well... no matter.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You're going to just let them walk away?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Alas, unlike Quintus, I am not in such a hurry. Why would I want to face two Hunters at once and cut my life even shorter?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Is there a difference between a moment and an instant?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: There isn't, but seeing you revert to your old temperament sure brings me back, Laurentina. After all, you were in a coma until the first experiment began.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: How have you been since you left us?
Specter's lips curl into a subtle smile.
It is the most beautiful smile she's shown tonight.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's getting faster!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I've already... *pant*... put two more holes in it. Just how much blood can it have in there?!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Two? How did you...?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I'll tell you later. I don't think my stamina is going to last much longer—

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —It's been cannibalizing its own kind this whole time! No wonder!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Watch out, it's coming at us!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: —Urgh!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ishar-mla, where is He?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Answer. I wish to know.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: You monster!
Before Irene can fire her handcannon, the Seaborn lurches forward.
As the wall cracks audibly, Skadi leaps back with tremendous force, before closing the gap between her and the Seaborn almost instantly.
Her lethal strikes once again bite down on thin air.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (None of her hits landed?!)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...Insufficient.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Nutrients. Time. All insufficient.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ishar-mla, we require answers. But, I can feel His presence.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: With words, we shall implore.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ishar-mla, even if He does not answer, it does not mean, He is not there.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Even if He is not there, it does not mean, that our kind, has lost its way.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Our kind, has found its way. We will, seize our own fate.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Survival, the primary goal.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Do all of you love rambling on while trying to kill us?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Don't overthink this, and don't plan on returning to the ocean either!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: —Insufficient, far from enough.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: But, soon.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Ugh—! Cover your ears! Irene!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Huh? Ah!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Screeching howl) —!

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: (Rasping murmur) —Roci—nante—

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: (Brays)

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: The waves are coming. We wait for them. We will wait outside. With weapons, we tear them— Let us go!

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: (Echoing braying)
The Seaborn's murmurs can be heard from afar. Gladiia frowns slightly.
For an ordinary land-walker to recklessly make contact with the ocean and win eternal madness is certainly conceivable.
But what of the other Seaborn that obeyed him?
But Gladiia does not think about it too deeply. Because a nauseating premonition is gnawing at her nerves—
—It makes her neck itch.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What's happening up there?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This ship has been adrift at sea for more than sixty years.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: If they'd wanted to do away with it, or even simply treated it and its crew as enemies, the Stultifera Navis would've sunk long ago.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...So instead, they're assimilating it.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: They've treated the ship as a part of their environment. For whatever reason, they must've allowed it to survive in their waters.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But now, the situation has changed.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The nethersea brand? Since when? And how did it spread this quickly?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This ship will most certainly sink.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Gladiia.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Have you ever considered why an Ægir as talented as Breogan chose, in his final hour, to design the key the way he did?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It should've unlocked the secrets Ægir has long dreamed of. It is the quintessence of his life's work.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: So why is just anyone's blood enough to activate it? Why would he let it fall into the hands of a frail knight?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: We did silence that thing. But they probably don't need any gods at all. Only humanity, in their impotence and hypocrisy, would fold their hands together and pray to the ocean, finding far too much solace within it.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: We need to make use of what little time we have, Gladiia.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're still thinking about the incident with Thiago.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Mm, not quite. Of all the tragedies I've endured, his is hardly worth mentioning. Nothing more than a grain of sand on the beach.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: But how much sand does this beach require?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: This ship wasn't brought by the Penal Battalion. Most of the town's vessels were brought under their supervision, and the few that weren't were... forgotten, stranded along the shore.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then we've saved quite a bit of time thanks to someone's carelessness.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I can't help but think of how much more will be forgotten, what else will be stranded.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Kal'tsit, if the land of Terra were a ship, what kind of vessel do you think it would be?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're almost at the Eye of Iberia.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: ...That we are.
